params.name: id
params.description: ID of the Item. ID format — `item_123456789`

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text search filter. For best results, use the payroll platform or employer's full name.

params.name: id
params.description:
Filter by Item ID.
Multiple Item IDs can also be searched at once using either method:

1. `/v2/items?id=item_000000001,item_000000002`
2. `/v2/items?id=item_000000001&id=item_000000002`

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter by `status` value.

Multiple `status` values can also be searched at once using either method:

1. `/v2/items?status=healthy,issues`
2. `/v2/items?status=healthy&status=issues`

Filtering by both `healthy` and `issues` will return all Items that currently support new payroll connections.

params.name: mapping_status
params.description:
Filter by `mapping_status` value.

Multiple `mapping_status` values can also be searched at once using either method:

1. `/v2/items?mapping_status=verified,mapped`
2. `/v2/items?mapping_status=verified&mapping_status=mapped`

params.name: min_matching_score
params.description:
Only returns items with a [matching_score](/api-reference/items#object-matching_score) greater than or equal to this value.
`min_matching_score` should be used together with the `q` "free-text search" query parameter.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of Item objects returned [per page](/api-guide/overview#pagination). Default: 10. Maximum: 200.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The URL returned in `next` or `previous` used to retrieve another [page](/api-guide/overview#pagination) of results.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of all Item objects.
